topic: Your Phone's Brain is Made of Sand!
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your phone's smart brain is made from ordinary sand? 🤯

💡 Your phone's lightning-fast chips are crafted from silicon, the main ingredient found in ordinary sand.
